{"notes":"- **Games**: A new Games mode (Alt+3). RuForge detects your games and gives each one a page with videos, guides and search, plus an in-game overlay, a pinned glance and ghost mode for the mini player while you play.
- **Playlists**: A new playlist page with Resume, a sortable table, drag to reorder any playlist, and a Suggested shelf of YouTube videos you don't have yet.
- **Dynamic Island**: Choose Always, When active or Off in Settings > Appearance so it stays out of the way of other apps.
- **From the dev**: Announcements and polls in the bell, with voting and live results.
- **Smaller installer**: ffmpeg and yt-dlp download on first launch after you confirm, and an update button sits at the bottom of the sidebar when an update is waiting.","additions":["Games: new Games mode on its own rail item (Alt+3) with a home page and game pages (Overview, Videos, Guides, Search)","Games: detects Minecraft Bedrock, Minecraft Java and any game you add from Steam or the Microsoft
